## Definition of Done

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` invariants respected (file size, typed errors, no fabricated data, no hard-coded text, no telemetry).
- [ ] Tests added or updated; regression test for every fixed bug; CI green.
- [ ] UI: loading, empty and error states; light, dark, reduced motion, 200% font scale; accessibility checked.
- [ ] No secret or personal data logged or committed; new third-party calls opt-in and disclosed.
- [ ] New dependency justified in a one-line comment and approved, or none added.
- [ ] Contracts, migrations and ADRs updated and tested where affected.
- [ ] README, `AGENTS.md` and `.env.example` updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Diff read in full.
